probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, Judah Fortgang, PFF R&D+Betting; charts footer 'Data: PFF'; deep-scroll catalog of ~209 analytical posts, read 2026-10-15): a play is DISRUPTED when the pass rush forces the QB off his read OR when no player in the coverage unit makes a mistake — i.e., the defense wins the play's structure either by pressure timing or by coverage integrity. Charted as QB EPA with disruption vs without. Role in-engine: disruption is the defensive-side primitive under several dossier premise shapes — it names the event (QB knocked off the read) that pressure counting stats only approximate. C-310 is its pressure-timing component; C-314 is its coverage component.
